name: Anasuya
reason: Classic name of Atri's wife; meaning sound.

name: Devahuti
reason: Epic mother of Kapila; correct and auspicious.

name: Shabari
reason: Rama devotee; used as a girl's name.

name: Renuka
reason: Mother of Parashurama, worshipped as Renuka/Yellamma; commonly given.

name: Menaka
reason: Apsara name, in real use; meaning acceptable though some families avoid it.

name: Tilottama
reason: Used name, but tila means sesame seed; meaning weak.

fix.name: Tilottama
fix.meaning_en: Made from the finest sesame-seed-sized particles of beauty; the celestial nymph

name: Rati
reason: Suitable, but IAST/script have a wrong long vowel; word is rati.

name: Shachi
reason: Indra's consort, used as a girl's name; script and IAST correct.

name: Madri
reason: Pandu's wife; correct and in use.
